portada.frase: Today is the first day of the rest of your blessed life
portada.texto: Founder and Senior Pastor of Casa de Mi Gloria. Church planter, missional leader and international speaker, equipping leaders and advancing the Kingdom of God in Nicaragua.

parrafos: Since 2010, together with my wife Cristina, I have been the founder and Senior Pastor of Casa de Mi Gloria in Managua. I am a church planter, missional leader and international speaker, and my passion is equipping leaders to advance the Kingdom of God.
I graduated in Theology from Southwestern Assemblies of God University (SAGU) in Texas in 1994. I lead the radio program Faro del Espíritu and the El Faro Training Center.
With Cristina we founded the marriage ministry Defensores del Pacto and the Enamorados Congress, and we lead the Acahualinca Children's Center and the Managua Ministry Training Center.

inicio.mision: Passionate about fulfilling God's dream for Nicaragua, we have planted churches and developed projects, ministries and programs so that every person can know Jesus Christ, find salvation in Him, have their life transformed and reach the purpose for which they were designed.

ministerios.descripcion: A Christ-centered church: we focus on a relationship with God, not a religion. Our mission is to be Jesus' instrument to impact every life and reach every soul in this nation.
Bible-based radio program with a wide range of topics to nourish your spiritual life.
Venue for Christian events with a 250-seat auditorium, air-conditioned rooms and apartments with laundry service, in central Managua.
Center affiliated with Global University offering theological training to strengthen your service in God's work.
Provides education, food and spiritual care to the children of Acahualinca, one of the poorest communities in Nicaragua. 200 children are served every week, and you can be part of it.
Annual congress to build unbreakable marriages and strengthen couples on the biblical model, with God at the center.
